note: Runner: service/test/video.test.ts. Runners are ordinary risk; this file is the truth. Z-002 and Z-005 must FAIL against the tree at 5ca3b91 -- a defect spec proves itself by failing before (lessons/L-006).

cases.description: The Zoom OAuth connect callback stores the connection and writes nothing to schedules.

steps.assert: $after.location_value == $before.location_value (still null) -- no UPDATE of schedules occurred
exactly one video_connections row exists for (owner, 'zoom'), with a non-null refresh_token and fallback_url == 'https://us02web.zoom.us/j/1112223333'
a connection row exists for second@example.com with a null fallback_url -- the credential is stored even with no personal room

cases.description: No joinable link reaches an anonymous visitor. FAILS before the fix.

steps.assert: $html does not contain 'us02web.zoom.us' nor '/j/1112223333' anywhere, escaped or unescaped
$html contains 'Zoom — link arrives with the confirmation'
none of $m, $t, $g contains its location_value; each names its venue and says the link arrives with the confirmation
$z does not contain '/j/999' -- a minted URL is no more public than a stored one

cases.description: Non-conferencing kinds are not degraded: what the owner typed still shows publicly.

steps.assert: $i == 'Cafe Nero, 2nd floor'
$c == 'Ask on arrival'

cases.description: Zoom credentials are sealed at rest and recoverable only with TOKEN_KEY.

steps.assert: neither 'zoom-refresh-SENTINEL' nor 'zoom-access-SENTINEL' appears in any column of $row
$opened == 'zoom-refresh-SENTINEL'
$wrong is undefined -- never a partial value

cases.description: A stored fallback link no longer suppresses per-booking creation. FAILS before the fix.

steps.assert: $b.zoom_api recorded exactly one POST to /users/me/meetings, authorized with the stored connection's access token
$b.confirmation_mail location contains the minted join_url, not '/j/1112223333'

cases.description: An expired access token is refreshed, the rotated refresh token is persisted, and the booking still mints a room.

steps.assert: $b.zoom_api recorded a refresh grant before the create call
the sealed refresh_token now opens to the rotated value returned by the refresh, not 'old-refresh'
$b.confirmation_mail location contains the minted join_url
$b2 succeeded as a booking; the connection row's status is 'error' with a non-null error_reason; nothing threw

cases.description: The fallback chain runs in the stated order, and only the confirmed audience ever sees its result.

steps.assert: $b1 made no Zoom create call and the confirmation carries the calendar-minted URL (step 1)
$b2 confirmation carries the per-booking join_url from the connection (step 2)
$b3 confirmation carries the per-booking join_url from the Server-to-Server path (step 3)
$b4 confirmation carries '/j/typed' (step 4)
$b5 confirmation carries '/j/pmi' (step 5)
$b6 confirmation says 'Zoom — link arrives with the confirmation' (step 6)
for every one of b1..b6 the public booking page rendered before the booking contained no join URL

cases.description: Zoom failing never fails a booking, and the owner's token is used for nothing else.

steps.assert: $b returned a confirmed booking with a booking id, and both booker and host confirmation mails were sent
$b2 returned a confirmed booking
across every call in this suite, the only Zoom API paths contacted with a stored access token are the token endpoint and /users/me/meetings

cases.description: The integrations card reads connected-state from the connection, and its copy matches Z3d.

steps.assert: $h1 shows 'Connected ✓' and names the connected account's email or display name
$h2 shows 'Not Connected' -- a stamped location_value is not a connection
$h3 shows 'Connected ✓'

$h1 does not claim a unique room unconditionally: its copy states the fallback order, and the static-link field's help text says the link is used only when a per-booking room cannot be created and is never shown before a booking

cases.description: Disconnect and account deletion both remove the stored credential; the table exists on both dialects.

steps.assert: no video_connections row remains for that owner, and the schedule's location_value is null
no video_connections row remains for that owner -- verified by absence, in the same transaction as the rest of the erasure
the migration files exist for both dialects, are re-runnable (applying twice is a no-op), and the SQLite one is present in worker.ts's pre-loaded files list
